title: What Is AIVideosUGC? Company Facts for Sellers | AIVideosUGC
description: What AIVideosUGC makes from your product photos, how credits and plans work, what the tools don't do, and what you finish yourself after download.
lead: AIVideosUGC turns one product photo into store images and short video ads, with no studio and no casting. Here is what it does, what it costs, and what you finish after download.
summary: AIVideosUGC turns a product photo or a product page link into short video ads and store-ready images for online stores.
facts: AI product video tool and AI product photo tool for online stores
Ecommerce sellers, brands that sell through their own online stores, and marketers on Shopify, Amazon, TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook
6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds; 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4; made from a product photo, a product page link, or a text description
White-background photos, lifestyle scenes, model photos, background changes, and social ad images from a product photo
Monthly plans from $24.50 with 200 credits. The credit cost is shown before every job.
Held when a job starts, used when the file is delivered, returned automatically if a job fails
Downloaded photos and videos are cleared for commercial use and have no watermark
Uploads and results stay in the customer's account and are not public
not_offered: Spoken narration, music, or captions on product clips (add them in your editor after download; an AI actor clip speaks the one line you write)
A library of saved presenters you keep and reuse
A public way for other software to submit jobs
describe: After download, add captions, music, narration, prices, offers, and campaign settings in your editor or ad platform. Then check the file against your product facts and the rules of the place you will post it.

faq.a: An online tool that turns a product photo or a product page link into short video ads and store-ready product images for online stores.
Monthly plans start at $24.50 with 200 credits. Each video or photo shows its credit cost before it starts, and a failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Does an AIVideosUGC video include a spoken line?
faq.a: Product clips come without narration, music, or captions. Add those in your editor after download. An AI actor clip is different: the actor speaks the one line you write, with mouth movement that follows the words. See [AI spokesperson video](page:spokesperson-videos).

faq.q: What video settings can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds, and 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. The same product photo can become a vertical ad, a square clip, or a wide frame.

faq.q: How many credits does a video or photo use?
faq.a: A photo uses 24 credits. Videos use 24 for 6 seconds, 40 for 10 seconds, 60 for 15 seconds, and 120 for 30 seconds. The exact cost is on screen before the job starts.

faq.q: Can I use the results in ads and on my store?
faq.a: Yes. Downloaded photos and videos are cleared for commercial use and have no watermark. You can run them on marketplaces, social platforms, and your own store, under each platform's rules.
